errors.text: No supporting evidence is cited for nitrogen incorporation, nitride-layer formation, or the claimed 20% wear improvement.
The alloy composition and coating architecture are unspecified, so the proposed nitriding response cannot be reliably evaluated.

The falsification experiment tests only 25°C and 1 m/s, despite claiming improvement across temperatures up to 500°C; failure or success at one condition cannot resolve the temperature-wide hypothesis.
The proposal does not reconstruct the target temperature-dependent lattice-disorder and dislocation mechanism or its critical deterioration near 900 K.
